text: The Forest Hill, Leaside and North Toronto Arena Nominating Panel on April 16, 2018, considered a report (April 6, 2018) from the City Clerk respecting the appointment of a member to the Leaside Memorial Community Gardens Arena Board.

North York Community Council: 1. Appointed Glenn Asano to the Leaside Memorial Community Gardens Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending February 22, 2021, and until successors are appointed. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (April 6, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Leaside Memorial Community Gardens Arena Board.
